title: Ending Poverty in Australia (Antipoverty Commission) Bill 2023
short_title: Ending Poverty in Australia (Antipoverty Commission) Bill 2023

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: This bill would create a permanent, independent body to advise Parliament on poverty and social security payments.
The Antipoverty Commission would run reviews of poverty levels and payment adequacy, with its leaders chosen by a parliamentary committee.
The government would be required to publicly answer the Commission's recommendations.
changes: Establishes the Antipoverty Commission as a legislated, independent advisory body.
Requires the Commission to conduct antipoverty reviews and social security payment reviews.
Mandates that the government publicly respond to the Commission's recommendations.
summary.affected: People living in poverty, recipients of income support, and the Australian Parliament and government.
